name: pulse
label: Pulse
about: A smooth pulse between low and high, rate times a second. Its time input, left unlinked, is the game time (paused with the game; a photo's held moment keeps it); link a Time node or anything else to drive it.
glsl: result = mix(low, high, 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(6.28318531 * rate * time));
